entries.name: tlsf_fli

entries.canonical_statement: tlsf_fli((s : W32)) == word_sub(word(31), int_clz(s))

entries.name: tlsf_sli
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_sli((s : W32), (f : W32))
  == word_and(word_jushr(s, word_sub(f, word(4))), word(15))

entries.name: tlsf_mask
entries.statement: tlsf_mask((s : W32)) == ((1w <<₃₂ tlsf_fli((s : W32)) −₃₂ 4w) −₃₂ 1w)
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_mask((s : W32))
  == word_sub(word_jshl(word(1), word_sub(tlsf_fli(s), word(4))), word(1))

entries.name: tlsf_round
entries.statement:
tlsf_round((s : W32))
  == ((s : W32) +₃₂ tlsf_mask((s : W32)) &₃₂ word_not(tlsf_mask((s : W32))))
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_round((s : W32))
  == word_and(word_add(s, tlsf_mask(s)), word_not(tlsf_mask(s)))

entries.name: tlsf_exp_lt

entries.name: tlsf_fli_clz

entries.name: tlsf_fli_val
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32) (f : Num)
if
  1. EXP(2, f) <= val(s)
  2. val(s) < EXP(2, f + 1)
then
  val(tlsf_fli(s)) == f

entries.name: tlsf_sli_val
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
then
  4 <= val(tlsf_fli(s))
  && val(tlsf_fli(s)) <= 31
  && val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s)))
       == MOD(DIV(val(s), EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4)), 16)

entries.name: tlsf_class_num
entries.statement:
∀ (v k : Num)
if
  1. EXP(2, k + 4) <= v
  2. v < EXP(2, k + 5)
then
  16 <= DIV(v, EXP(2, k))
  && DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) < 32
  && MOD(DIV(v, EXP(2, k)), 16) == DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) - 16
  && DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) * EXP(2, k) <= v
  && v < DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) * EXP(2, k) + EXP(2, k)

entries.name: tlsf_class
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
then
  4 <= val(tlsf_fli(s))
  && val(tlsf_fli(s)) <= 31
  && val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s))) < 16
  && (16 + val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s)))) * EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4) <= val(
       s)
  && val(s) < (17 + val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s)))) * EXP(
       2,
       val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4)

entries.name: tlsf_round_val
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 4160749568
then
  val(tlsf_round(s)) == EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4) * DIV(
    val(s) + (EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4) - 1),
    EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4))

entries.name: tlsf_class_exact
entries.statement:
∀ (x : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(x)
  2. MOD(val(x), EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(x)) - 4)) == 0
then
  (16 + val(tlsf_sli(x, tlsf_fli(x)))) * EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(x)) - 4) == val(x)

entries.name: tlsf_round_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 4160749568
then
  val(s) <= val(tlsf_round(s))
  && val(tlsf_round(s)) < val(s) + EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4)
  && (16 + val(tlsf_sli(tlsf_round(s), tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s))))) * EXP(
       2,
       val(tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s))) - 4)
       == val(tlsf_round(s))

entries.name: tlsf_find_sound
entries.statement:
∀ (s t : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 4160749568
  3. 16 <= val(t)
  4. val(tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s))) < val(tlsf_fli(t))
     || val(tlsf_fli(t)) == val(tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s)))
        && val(tlsf_sli(tlsf_round(s), tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s)))) <= val(
             tlsf_sli(t, tlsf_fli(t)))
then
  val(s) <= val(t)

entries.name: tlsf_class_mono
entries.statement:
∀ (x y : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(x)
  2. val(x) <= val(y)
then
  val(tlsf_fli(x)) < val(tlsf_fli(y))
or
  val(tlsf_fli(y)) == val(tlsf_fli(x))
  && val(tlsf_sli(x, tlsf_fli(x))) <= val(tlsf_sli(y, tlsf_fli(y)))

entries.name: tlsf_sync

tlsf_sync((s : W32), (n : Num), (ne : (Num) -> Bool))
  == (∀ k : Num, bit(k, s) == (k < n && ne(k)))

entries.statement:
∀ (s j : W32) (n : Num) (ne : (Num) -> Bool)
if
  1. val(j) < n
  2. n <= 32
  3. tlsf_sync(s, n, ne)
then
  tlsf_sync((s |₃₂ 1w <<₃₂ j), n, (k : Num) => k == val(j) || ne(k))

entries.name: TLSF physical chain and bin correspondence (tlsf_physical.mbt)
tlsf_size
entries.canonical_statement: tlsf_size((hd : W32)) == word_and(hd, word(4294967292))

entries.name: tlsf_used
entries.statement: tlsf_used((hd : W32)) == !(((hd : W32) &₃₂ 1w) == 0w)
entries.canonical_statement: tlsf_used((hd : W32)) == !(word_and(hd, word(1)) == word(0))

entries.name: tlsf_last
entries.statement: tlsf_last((hd : W32)) == !(((hd : W32) &₃₂ 2w) == 0w)
entries.canonical_statement: tlsf_last((hd : W32)) == !(word_and(hd, word(2)) == word(0))

entries.name: tlsf_level_of
entries.statement:
tlsf_level_of((hd : W32))
  == val((27w −₃₂ word(word_clz(tlsf_size((hd : W32))))))
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_level_of((hd : W32)) == (val : (W32) -> Num)(
  (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
    (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
    (word : (Num) -> W32)((word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(tlsf_size(hd)))))

entries.name: tlsf_slot_of
entries.statement:
tlsf_slot_of((hd : W32)) == val(
  (
    tlsf_size((hd : W32))
    >>>₃₂ 27w −₃₂ word(word_clz(tlsf_size((hd : W32)))) &₃₂ 15w))
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_slot_of((hd : W32)) == val(
  word_and(
    word_jushr(
      tlsf_size(hd),
      word_sub(word(27), word(word_clz(tlsf_size(hd))))),
    word(15)))

entries.name: tlsf_header_class_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (hd : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(hd))
then
  tlsf_level_of(hd) < 28
  && tlsf_slot_of(hd) < 16

entries.name: tlsf_header_class
entries.statement:
∀ (hd : W32),
  tlsf_level_of(hd) == val((tlsf_fli(tlsf_size(hd)) −₃₂ 4w))
  && tlsf_slot_of(hd) == val(tlsf_sli(tlsf_size(hd), tlsf_fli(tlsf_size(hd))))
entries.canonical_statement:
∀ (hd : W32),
  tlsf_level_of(hd) == val(word_sub(tlsf_fli(tlsf_size(hd)), word(4)))
  && tlsf_slot_of(hd) == val(tlsf_sli(tlsf_size(hd), tlsf_fli(tlsf_size(hd))))

entries.name: tlsf_block_ok
entries.statement:
tlsf_block_ok((a : Num), (lim : Num), (m : W32), (hd : (W32) -> W32)) == (
  val(m) == a
  && !(m == 0w)
  && MOD(a, 8) == 0
  && 16 <= val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  && MOD(val(tlsf_size(hd(m))), 8) == 0
  && a + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) <= lim)
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_block_ok((a : Num), (lim : Num), (m : W32), (hd : (W32) -> W32)) == (
  val(m) == a
  && !(m == word(0))
  && MOD(a, 8) == 0
  && 16 <= val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  && MOD(val(tlsf_size(hd(m))), 8) == 0
  && a + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) <= lim)

entries.name: tlsf_layout
entries.statement:
tlsf_layout(
  (p : W32),
  (a : Num),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  NIL,
  (hd : (W32) -> W32))
  == (a == lim && p == top)
&& tlsf_layout(
     (p : W32),
     (a : Num),
     (lim : Num),
     (top : W32),
     CONS((m : W32), (xs : List[W32])),
     (hd : (W32) -> W32)) == (
     tlsf_block_ok(a, lim, m, hd)
     && tlsf_last(hd(m)) == (xs == NIL)
     && tlsf_layout(m, a + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m))), lim, top, xs, hd))

entries.name: tlsf_block_field_address
entries.statement:
∀ (a lim k : Num) (m : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_block_ok(a, lim, m, hd)
  2. lim <= 4294967296
  3. k <= 16
then
  val((m +₃₂ word(k))) == val(m) + k
entries.canonical_statement:
∀ (a lim k : Num) (m : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_block_ok(a, lim, m, hd)
  2. lim <= 4294967296
  3. k <= 16
then
  val(word_add(m, word(k))) == val(m) + k

entries.name: tlsf_block_spare_end
entries.statement:
∀ (a lim : Num) (m : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_block_ok(a, lim, m, hd)
then
  val(m) + 16 + (val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) - 8)
    == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))

entries.name: tlsf_layout_lower
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top m : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. MEM(m, xs)
then
  a <= val(m)

entries.name: tlsf_layout_members
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top m : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. MEM(m, xs)
then
  tlsf_block_ok(val(m), lim, m, hd)

entries.name: tlsf_layout_order
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
then
  PAIRWISE(
    (m : W32) => (n : W32) => val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) <= val(n),
    xs)

entries.name: tlsf_layout_distinct
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
then
  PAIRWISE((m : W32) => (n : W32) => !(m == n), xs)

entries.name: tlsf_count
entries.statement:
tlsf_count((m : W32), (xs : List[W32]))
  == LENGTH(FILTER((x : W32) => x == m, xs))

entries.name: tlsf_count_member
entries.statement: ∀ (m : W32) (xs : List[W32]), MEM(m, xs) == (0 < tlsf_count(m, xs))

entries.name: tlsf_count_zero
entries.statement: ∀ (m : W32) (xs : List[W32]), (tlsf_count(m, xs) == 0) == !MEM(m, xs)

entries.name: tlsf_bins_match
entries.statement:
tlsf_bins_match(
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (
    ∀ m : W32,
      MEM(m, xs)
      && !tlsf_used(hd(m)) → tlsf_count(
           m,
           bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(m)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(m))))
           == 1)
  && (
       ∀ f : Num,
         ∀ j : Num,
           ∀ m : W32,
             f < 28
             && j < 16
             && MEM(m, bl(f, j)) → MEM(m, xs)
             && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
             && tlsf_level_of(hd(m)) == f
             && tlsf_slot_of(hd(m)) == j))

entries.name: tlsf_bins_match_exact
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (m : W32)
  (f j : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. f < 28
  3. j < 16
then
  tlsf_count(m, bl(f, j)) == (
    if MEM(m, xs)
    && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
    && tlsf_level_of(hd(m)) == f
    && tlsf_slot_of(hd(m)) == j { 1 } else { 0 })

entries.name: tlsf_bins_match_member
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (m : W32)
  (f j : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. f < 28
  3. j < 16
then
  MEM(m, bl(f, j)) == (
    MEM(m, xs)
    && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
    && tlsf_level_of(hd(m)) == f
    && tlsf_slot_of(hd(m)) == j)

entries.name: tlsf_bins_match_unique
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (m : W32)
  (f j g k : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. f < 28
  3. j < 16
  4. g < 28
  5. k < 16
  6. MEM(m, bl(f, j))
  7. MEM(m, bl(g, k))
then
  f == g
  && j == k
  && tlsf_count(m, bl(f, j)) == 1

entries.name: tlsf_bytes
entries.statement:
tlsf_bytes((a : Num), (n : Num))
  == ((h : Heap) => ∃ bs : List[Byte], LENGTH(bs) == n && pts(a, bs, h))

entries.name: tlsf_spare
tlsf_regions
entries.statement:
tlsf_regions((p : W32), NIL, (hd : (W32) -> W32)) == emp
&& tlsf_regions(
     (p : W32),
     CONS((m : W32), (xs : List[W32])),
     (hd : (W32) -> W32)) == (
     pts(val((m : W32)), serialise_i32((hd : (W32) -> W32)(m)))

  (addr : Num),

  (a : Num),

           (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>

       ∀ args : List[Value],

  2. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(hd))
  3. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd), tlsf_slot_of(hd)) == APPEND(us, CONS(m, vs))
then

    fs,

    inst,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2, V_num(ConstInt32(n)), l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>

          * fp(gs, ms))),
    [Local_get(0), Call(pop)],
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2, V_num(ConstInt32(n)), l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd))
          * pts(val((m +₃₂ 8w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_prev(us)))

              tlsf_pop_sb(hd, sb, APPEND(us, vs)),
              tlsf_pop_bl(hd, bl, APPEND(us, vs)))

    NIL)

entries.statement:
∀ (a z : Num)

  1. 8 <= z
then
  tlsf_bytes(a, z) == (
    (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ pf : W32,
        ∃ nf : W32,
          (
            (
              pts(a, serialise_i32(pf))
              * pts(a + 4, serialise_i32(nf))
              * tlsf_bytes(a + 8, z - 8))(h)))

entries.name: tlsf_focus_block
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
then
  tlsf_block_ok(val(m), lim, m, hd)
  && lim <= 4294967296

entries.name: tlsf_focus_last
entries.statement:
∀ (ys : List[W32]) (m d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, [m]), hd)
then
  top == m

                 sb,
                 bl)

        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_detached(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 ys,
                 m,
                 zs,
                 hd,
                 tlsf_pop_fl(hd(m), fl, sb, APPEND(us, vs)),
                 tlsf_pop_sb(hd(m), sb, APPEND(us, vs)),
                 tlsf_pop_bl(hd(m), bl, APPEND(us, vs)))

    NIL)

∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m hdr e fl pf0 nf0 : W32)
  (pop push lim2 : Num) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  2. MOD(lim2, 65536) == 0
  3. !((m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr)) == 0w)
  4. 16 <= val(
       tlsf_size(
         (tlsf_capacity_at(lim2, (m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr))) |₃₂ 2w)))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(e))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(m))
          * pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hdr))
          * pts(val((m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr))), serialise_i32(0w))
          * pts(val((m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr) +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(0w))
          * (
              (h : Heap) =>
                ms == lim2
                && (
                     (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
                       (
                         pts(
                           val((m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr) +₃₂ 8w)),
                           serialise_i32(pf0))
                         * pts(
                             val((m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr) +₃₂ 12w)),
                             serialise_i32(nf0))
                         * tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)
                         * fp(gs, ms)))(gs, ms, h)))),
    APPEND(
      tlsf_ensure_used_write(d, pop, push),
      [Local_get(1), Call(push), Drop]),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32((m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr))))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          pts(
            val((m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr))),
            serialise_i32(
              (
                tlsf_capacity_at(lim2, (m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr)))
                |₃₂ 2w)))
          * tlsf_bins(
              d,
              tlsf_push_fl(
                (
                  tlsf_capacity_at(lim2, (m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr)))
                  |₃₂ 2w),
                fl),
              tlsf_push_sb(
                (
                  tlsf_capacity_at(lim2, (m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr)))
                  |₃₂ 2w),
                sb),
              tlsf_push_bl(
                (
                  tlsf_capacity_at(lim2, (m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr)))
                  |₃₂ 2w),
                (m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr)),
                bl))
          * (
              (h : Heap) =>
                ms == lim2
                && (
                     (
                       pts(
                         val(tlsf_top_cell(d)),
                         serialise_i32((m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr))))
                       * pts(val(m), serialise_i32((hdr &₃₂ 4294967293w)))
                       * pts(
                           val((m +₃₂ 8w +₃₂ tlsf_size(hdr) +₃₂ 4w)),
                           serialise_i32(m))
                       * fp(gs, ms))(h))))),
    NIL)

entries.name: tlsf_ensure_growth_fit
entries.statement:
∀ (ys : List[W32]) (d s m : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, [m]), hd)
  2. 16 <= val(s)
  3. val(s) <= 4160749568
  4. DIV(lim, 65536) + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) <= 65536
then
  lim <= lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536
  && lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536 <= 4294967296
  && MOD(lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536, 65536) == 0
  && tlsf_physical_ok(
       d,
       lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536,
       tlsf_grow_top(hd, m, lim),
       tlsf_grow_chain(APPEND(ys, [m]), hd, m, lim),
       tlsf_grow_headers(
         hd,
         m,
         lim,
         lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536))
  && !tlsf_used(
       tlsf_grow_headers(
         hd,
         m,
         lim,
         lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536,
         tlsf_grow_top(hd, m, lim)))
  && val(tlsf_ensure_expected(s)) <= val(
       tlsf_size(
         tlsf_grow_headers(
           hd,
           m,
           lim,
           lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536,
           tlsf_grow_top(hd, m, lim))))

  (d c : W32) (pop push lim : Num) (lc0 : List[Value]) (R : GProp)
  (rest : List[B_e]) (labels : List[SAssn])
if
  1. lim <= 4294967296
  2. ∀ gs : List[Value],
       ∀ ms : Num,
         ∀ h : Heap,
           (
             (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
               ms == lim && R(gs, lim, h))(gs, ms, h) → rp(
             [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))],
             lc0,
             gs,
             ms,
             h)
  3. DIV(lim, 65536) + val(c) <= 65536 → sl_triple_g(
       G,
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       rp,
       st(
         NIL,
         lc0,
         (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           ms == lim + val(c) * 65536
           && ((R(gs, lim) * pts(lim, REPLICATE(val(c) * 65536, 0w)))(h))),
       rest,
       Q,
       labels)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,

    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(c))],
      lc0,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim && R(gs, ms, h)),
    APPEND([Memory_grow], APPEND(tlsf_ensure_guard(d, pop, push), rest)),
    Q,
    labels)

  4. lim + delta <= 4294967296

       tlsf_large(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, [m]), hd, fl, sb, bl)
       * pts(lim, REPLICATE(delta, 0w))
       * fp)(heap0)
then
  (
    (
      pts((val : (W32) -> Num)((word : (Num) -> W32)(lim)), serialise_i32(0w))
      * pts(val((word(lim) +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(0w))
      * tlsf_bytes(

    * tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)
    * fp)(heap0)

  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, m)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && star(
             tlsf_free_pending(
               d,
               lim,
               top,
               ys,
               m,
               CONS(r, zs),
               hd,
               fl,
               sb,
               bl),
             fp(gs, ms),
             h)),
    tlsf_free_next_args(d, pop, push),
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(r))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(r)), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && star(
             tlsf_free_pending(
               d,
               lim,
               top,
               ys,
               m,
               CONS(r, zs),
               hd,
               fl,
               sb,
               bl),
             fp(gs, ms),
             h)))

  (us vs : List[W32]) (fp : GProp)

  1. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(hd))
  2. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd), tlsf_slot_of(hd)) == APPEND(us, CONS(m, vs))

  sl_triple_g(

      sfunc_ind(inst, pop),
      tlsf_pop_code(d),
      [V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)),

  6. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))
  7. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, APPEND(ys, zs)) → nh(x) == hd(x)
  8. (
       pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(top))
       * tlsf_regions(0w, ys, hd)
       * pts(val(m), serialise_i32(nh(m)))
       * pts(val((m +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, ys)))
       * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m))))
       * pts(val(r), serialise_i32(hd(r)))

       * tlsf_bytes(val(r) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(r))))
       * tlsf_regions(m, zs, hd)
       * tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)
       * fp)(h)

entries.name: tlsf_initialize_work
entries.statement:
tlsf_initialize_work(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (h0 : W32),
  (published : Bool),
  (top : W32),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && (
         (
           pts(val(tlsf_top_cell((d : W32))), serialise_i32((top : W32)))
           * pts(
               val(tlsf_initialize_origin((d : W32))),
               serialise_i32((h0 : W32)))
           * pts(
               val((tlsf_initialize_origin((d : W32)) +₃₂ 4w)),
               serialise_i32(0w))
           * tlsf_spare(
               tlsf_initialize_origin((d : W32)),
               tlsf_initialize_header(d, (lim : Num)))
           * pts(val(tlsf_base((d : W32))) + 1912, REPLICATE(264, 0w))
           * if (published : Bool) {
               tlsf_bins(
                 (d : W32),
                 tlsf_push_fl(tlsf_initialize_header(d, (lim : Num)), 0w),
                 tlsf_push_sb(
                   tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
                   (f : Num) => 0w),
                 tlsf_push_bl(
                   tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
                   tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
                   (f : Num) => (j : Num) => NIL)) } else {
               (
                 pts(
                   val((tlsf_initialize_origin((d : W32)) +₃₂ 8w)),
                   serialise_i32(0w))
                 * pts(
                     val((tlsf_initialize_origin((d : W32)) +₃₂ 12w)),
                     serialise_i32(0w))
                 * tlsf_bins(
                     (d : W32),
                     0w,
                     (f : Num) => 0w,
                     (f : Num) => (j : Num) => NIL)) }
           * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h)))
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_initialize_work(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (h0 : W32),
  (published : Bool),
  (top : W32),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && star(
         pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(top)),
         star(
           pts(val(tlsf_initialize_origin(d)), serialise_i32(h0)),
           star(
             pts(
               val(word_add(tlsf_initialize_origin(d), word(4))),
               serialise_i32(word(0))),
             star(
               tlsf_spare(
                 tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
                 tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim)),
               star(
                 pts(val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1912, REPLICATE(264, word(0))),
                 star(
                   if published {
                     tlsf_bins(
                       d,
                       tlsf_push_fl(
                         tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
                         word(0)),
                       tlsf_push_sb(
                         tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
                         (f : Num) => word(0)),
                       tlsf_push_bl(
                         tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
                         tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
                         (f : Num) => (j : Num) => NIL)) } else {
                     star(
                       pts(
                         val(
                           word_add(
                             tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
                             word(8))),
                         serialise_i32(word(0))),
                       star(
                         pts(
                           val(
                             word_add(
                               tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
                               word(12))),
                           serialise_i32(word(0))),
                         tlsf_bins(
                           d,
                           word(0),
                           (f : Num) => word(0),
                           (f : Num) => (j : Num) => NIL))) },
                   fp(gs, ms)))))),
         h))

       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  4. keep(
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       lift(
         st(
           NIL,
           lc0,
           (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
             tlsf_initialize_pre(d, lim, before, fp, NIL, gs, ms, h)),
         fr),
       s,
       f,
       vs)
  5. reduce_trans(
       (s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Call(j))])),
       (s2, f2, es2))
then
  ∃ (res : List[Value]),
    es2 == MAP(v_to_e, res)
    && keep(
         fs,
         tabs,
         inst,
         lift(
           st(
             NIL,
             lc0,
             (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
               tlsf_initialize_post(d, lim, before, fp, NIL, gs, ms, h)),
           fr),
         s2,
         f2,
         res)
or
  es2 == [Trap]
  && keep(
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       lift(tlsf_initialize_abort(d, lim, before, fp), fr),
       s2,
       f2,
       NIL)
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)

entries.name: tlsf_small_total
entries.statement: tlsf_small_total((s : Num)) == DIV(1056, 8 + s)

entries.name: tlsf_small_slot
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (i : Num))
  == word(val(p) + 32 + (8 + s) * i)

entries.name: tlsf_small_slots
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_slots((p : W32), (s : Num), 0) == NIL
&& tlsf_small_slots((p : W32), (s : Num), SUC((n : Num)))
     == APPEND(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n), [tlsf_small_slot(p, s, n)])

entries.name: tlsf_small_used
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32]))
  == LENGTH(cached) + LENGTH(live)

entries.name: tlsf_small_partition
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_partition(
  (p : W32),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == (
  (
    ∀ b : W32,
      tlsf_count(b, APPEND(loc, APPEND(cached, live))) == (
        if MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) { 1 } else {
          0 }))
  && LENGTH(loc) + tlsf_small_used(cached, live) == tlsf_small_total(s))

entries.name: tlsf_small_page_ok
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_page_ok(
  (lim : Num),
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == (
  !(p == 0w)
  && MOD(val(p), 8) == 0
  && lim <= 4294967296
  && val(p) + 8 + cap <= lim
  && 1080 <= cap
  && 8 <= s
  && s <= 256
  && MOD(s, 8) == 0
  && tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live))
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_small_page_ok(
  (lim : Num),
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == (
  !(p == word(0))
  && MOD(val(p), 8) == 0
  && lim <= 4294967296
  && val(p) + 8 + cap <= lim
  && 1080 <= cap
  && 8 <= s
  && s <= 256
  && MOD(s, 8) == 0
  && tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live))

entries.name: tlsf_small_lists_ok
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_lists_ok(
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (
    ∀ p : W32,
      MEM(p, ps) → tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
      && 0 < tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))
      && (
           ∀ b : W32,
             MEM(b, cached(p)) → tlsf_count(b, fast(DIV(sz(p), 8))) == 1)
      && (
           tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(sz(p)) → tlsf_count(
             p,
             partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))
             == 1))
  && (
       ∀ j : Num,
         ∀ b : W32,
           j < 33
           && MEM(b, fast(j)) → (
                ∃ p : W32, MEM(p, ps) && sz(p) == 8 * j && MEM(b, cached(p))))
  && (
       ∀ j : Num,
         ∀ p : W32,
           j < 33
           && MEM(p, partial(j)) → MEM(p, ps)
           && sz(p) == 8 * j
           && 0 < tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))
           && tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(sz(p))))

entries.name: tlsf_small_backing
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_backing(
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (lim : Num)) == (
  ∀ p : W32,
    MEM(p, ps) → MEM(p, xs)
    && tlsf_used(hd(p))
    && tlsf_small_page_ok(
         lim,
         p,
         val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
         sz(p),
         loc(p),
         cached(p),
         live(p)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_count_cons
entries.statement:
∀ (b a : W32) (xs : List[W32]),
  tlsf_count(b, CONS(a, xs)) == (if a == b { 1 } else { 0 }) + tlsf_count(b, xs)

entries.name: tlsf_small_count_append
entries.statement:
∀ (b : W32) (xs ys : List[W32]),
  tlsf_count(b, APPEND(xs, ys)) == tlsf_count(b, xs) + tlsf_count(b, ys)

entries.name: tlsf_small_partition_checkout
entries.statement:
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, CONS(b, cached), live)
then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, CONS(b, live))

entries.name: tlsf_small_partition_release
entries.statement:
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if

then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, CONS(b, loc), cached, live)

entries.name: tlsf_small_partition_export
entries.statement:
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, CONS(b, loc), NIL, live)
then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, NIL, loc, CONS(b, live))

entries.name: tlsf_small_accounting
entries.statement:
∀ (p : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live)
then
  tlsf_small_used(cached, live) <= tlsf_small_total(s)
  && (tlsf_small_used(cached, live) < tlsf_small_total(s)) == !(loc == NIL)

entries.name: tlsf_small_reclaimable
entries.statement:
∀ (cached live : List[W32]),
  (tlsf_small_used(cached, live) == 0) == (cached == NIL && live == NIL)

entries.name: tlsf_small_head
entries.statement: tlsf_small_head((xs : List[W32])) == (if xs == NIL { 0w } else { HD(xs) })
entries.canonical_statement: tlsf_small_head((xs : List[W32])) == (if xs == NIL { word(0) } else { HD(xs) })

entries.name: tlsf_small_links
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_links(NIL) == emp
&& tlsf_small_links(CONS((b : W32), (bs : List[W32]))) == (
     pts(val((b : W32)) + 8, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((bs : List[W32]))))
     * tlsf_small_links((bs : List[W32])))
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_small_links(NIL) == emp
&& tlsf_small_links(CONS((b : W32), (bs : List[W32]))) == star(
     pts(val(b) + 8, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(bs))),
     tlsf_small_links(bs))

entries.name: tlsf_small_partial_links
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_partial_links((prev : W32), NIL) == emp
&& tlsf_small_partial_links((prev : W32), CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32]))) == (
     pts(val((p : W32)) + 24, serialise_i32((prev : W32)))
     * pts(
         val((p : W32)) + 28,
         serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((ps : List[W32]))))
     * tlsf_small_partial_links((p : W32), (ps : List[W32])))
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_small_partial_links((prev : W32), NIL) == emp
&& tlsf_small_partial_links((prev : W32), CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32]))) == star(
     pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(prev)),
     star(
       pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(ps))),
       tlsf_small_partial_links(p, ps)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_slot_heap
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_slot_heap((p : W32), (s : Num), (live : List[W32]), (i : Num)) == (
  pts(val(tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (i : Num))), serialise_i32(4w))
  * pts(
      val(tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (i : Num))) + 4,
      serialise_i32(p))
  * (
      if MEM(
        tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (i : Num)),
        (live : List[W32])) { emp } else {
        tlsf_bytes(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 12, s - 4) })
  * emp)
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_small_slot_heap((p : W32), (s : Num), (live : List[W32]), (i : Num)) == star(
  pts(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)), serialise_i32(word(4))),
  star(
    pts(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 4, serialise_i32(p)),
    star(
      if MEM(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i), live) { emp } else {
        tlsf_bytes(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 12, s - 4) },
      emp)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_page_heap
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_page_heap(
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == (
  pts(val((p : W32)) + 8, serialise_i32(word((s : Num))))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total((s : Num)))))
  * pts(
      val((p : W32)) + 16,
      serialise_i32(
        word(tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32])))))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 20, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((loc : List[W32]))))
  * (
      if tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32])) < tlsf_small_total(
        (s : Num)) { emp } else { tlsf_bytes(val((p : W32)) + 24, 8) })
  * tlsf_istar(
      tlsf_small_slot_heap((p : W32), (s : Num), (live : List[W32])),
      tlsf_small_total(s))
  * tlsf_small_links((loc : List[W32]))
  * tlsf_bytes(
      val((p : W32)) + 32 + (8 + (s : Num)) * tlsf_small_total(s),
      (cap : Num) - 24 - (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s))
  * emp)
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_small_page_heap(
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == star(
  pts(val(p) + 8, serialise_i32(word(s))),
  star(
    pts(val(p) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total(s)))),
    star(
      pts(val(p) + 16, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_used(cached, live)))),
      star(
        pts(val(p) + 20, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(loc))),
        star(
          if tlsf_small_used(cached, live) < tlsf_small_total(s) { emp } else {
            tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 24, 8) },
          star(
            tlsf_istar(
              tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, live),
              tlsf_small_total(s)),
            star(
              tlsf_small_links(loc),
              star(
                tlsf_bytes(
                  val(p) + 32 + (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s),
                  cap - 24 - (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s)),
                emp))))))))

entries.name: tlsf_small_pages_heap
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_pages_heap(
  NIL,
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]))
  == emp
&& tlsf_small_pages_heap(
     CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32])),
     (hd : (W32) -> W32),
     (sz : (W32) -> Num),
     (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
     (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
     (live : (W32) -> List[W32])) == (
     tlsf_small_page_heap(
       (p : W32),
       val(tlsf_size((hd : (W32) -> W32)(p))),
       (sz : (W32) -> Num)(p),
       (loc : (W32) -> List[W32])(p),
       (cached : (W32) -> List[W32])(p),
       (live : (W32) -> List[W32])(p))
     * tlsf_small_pages_heap(
         (ps : List[W32]),
         (hd : (W32) -> W32),
         (sz : (W32) -> Num),
         (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
         (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
         (live : (W32) -> List[W32])))

tlsf_small_pages_heap(
  NIL,
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]))
  == emp
&& tlsf_small_pages_heap(
     CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32])),
     (hd : (W32) -> W32),
     (sz : (W32) -> Num),
     (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
     (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),

     tlsf_small_page_heap(
       p,
       val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),

       cached(p),

     tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live))

entries.name: tlsf_small_table_item
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_table_item(
  (d : W32),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (j : Num)) == (
  pts(
    val(tlsf_base((d : W32))) + 1912 + 8 * (j : Num),
    serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((fast : (Num) -> List[W32])(j))))
  * pts(
      val(tlsf_base((d : W32))) + 1916 + 8 * (j : Num),
      serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((partial : (Num) -> List[W32])(j))))
  * tlsf_small_links((fast : (Num) -> List[W32])((j : Num)))
  * tlsf_small_partial_links(0w, (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])((j : Num)))
  * emp)
entries.canonical_statement:
tlsf_small_table_item(
  (d : W32),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (j : Num)) == star(
  pts(
    val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1912 + 8 * j,
    serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(fast(j)))),
  star(
    pts(
      val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1916 + 8 * j,
      serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(partial(j)))),
    star(
      tlsf_small_links(fast(j)),
      star(tlsf_small_partial_links(word(0), partial(j)), emp))))

entries.name: tlsf_small_table
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_table(
  (d : W32),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))

entries.name: tlsf_small
entries.statement:
tlsf_small(
  (d : W32),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
    && (
         (
           tlsf_small_pages_heap(
             (ps : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (sz : (W32) -> Num),
             (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (live : (W32) -> List[W32]))
           * tlsf_small_table(
               (d : W32),
               (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
               (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])))(h)))

tlsf_small(
  (d : W32),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)

entries.name: tlsf_allocator
entries.statement:
tlsf_allocator(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),

             (d : W32),

             (xs : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),

               (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),

tlsf_allocator(

entries.name: tlsf_small_slots_member
entries.statement:
∀ (n s : Num) (p b : W32),
  MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n))
    == (∃ i : Num, i < n && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i))

entries.name: tlsf_small_slots_length
entries.statement: ∀ (n s : Num) (p : W32), LENGTH(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n)) == n

entries.name: tlsf_small_capacity
entries.statement:
∀ (s : Num)
if
  1. 8 <= s
  2. s <= 256
then
  4 <= tlsf_small_total(s)
  && tlsf_small_total(s) <= 66
  && (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s) <= 1056

entries.name: tlsf_small_slot_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (lim cap s i : Num) (p : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) == val(p) + 32 + (8 + s) * i
  && val(p) + 32 <= val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i))
  && val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 8 + s <= val(p) + 8 + cap
  && !(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i) == 0w)

∀ (lim cap s i : Num) (p : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if

  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) == val(p) + 32 + (8 + s) * i
  && val(p) + 32 <= val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i))
  && val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 8 + s <= val(p) + 8 + cap
  && !(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i) == word(0))

entries.name: tlsf_small_slot_injective
entries.statement:
∀ (lim cap s i j : Num) (p : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if

  == ((q : W32) => if q == p { vs } else { ff(q) })

entries.name: tlsf_block_free_partial
entries.statement:
tlsf_block_free_partial(
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (p : W32)) == (
  if tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) == tlsf_small_total(sz(p)) {
    tlsf_small_put_class(
      partial,
      DIV(sz(p), 8),
      CONS(p, partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))) } else {
    if tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) == 1 {
      tlsf_small_put_class(
        partial,
        DIV(sz(p), 8),
        tlsf_small_remove(p, partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))) } else { partial } })

    == 1 { tlsf_small_remove(p, ps) } else { ps })

  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (p : W32),

    && (
         (
           tlsf_allocator(
             (d : W32),
             (lim : Num),

  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp) (caller : List[Value])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(m, xs)
  3. !MEM(m, ps)
  4. tlsf_used(hd(m))
  5. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  6. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))

       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m))],
      caller,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_allocator(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 xs,
                 hd,

               * fp(gs, ms)
               * emp)(h))),
    [Call(free_idx)],
    st([V_num(ConstInt32(0w))], caller, tlsf_public_free_state(d, lim, fp)),
    NIL)

          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_pop_code(d))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_push_code(d))
  2. s_funcs(s) == fs
  3. s_tabs(s) == tabs
  4. f_inst(f) == inst
  5. lift(
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         ∃ args : List[Value],
           vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
           && lc == lc0
           && tlsf_public_free_pre(
                d,
                lim,
                top,
                xs,
                hd,
                fl,
                sb,
                bl,
                ps,
                sz,
                loc,
                cached,
                live,
                fast,
                partial,
                ptr,
                fp,
                args,
                gs,
                ms,
                h),
       fr,
       s,
       f,
       vs)
  6. reduce_trans(
       (s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), MAP(Basic, [Call(public_idx)]))),
       (s2, f2, es2))
then
  ∃ (vs2 : List[Value]),
    es2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs2)
    && s_funcs(s2) == fs
    && s_tabs(s2) == tabs
    && f_inst(f2) == inst
    && lift(
         (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
         (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           ∃ res : List[Value],
             vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
             && lc == lc0
             && tlsf_public_free_post(d, lim, fp, res, gs, ms, h),
         fr,
         s2,
         f2,
         vs2)
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)

tlsf_safer_abort
entries.statement:
tlsf_safer_abort(
  0,
  (s : Wstore),
  (f : Wframe),
  (es : List[Einstr]),
  (q : Assn),
  (l : List[Assn]),
  (rq : Assn),
  (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool))
  == true
&& tlsf_safer_abort(
     SUC((n : Num)),
     (s : Wstore),
     (f : Wframe),
     (es : List[Einstr]),
     (q : Assn),
     (l : List[Assn]),
     (rq : Assn),
     (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool)) == (
     (∃ vs : List[Value], es == MAP(v_to_e, vs) && q(s, f, vs))
     || (
          ∃ i : Num,
            ∃ vs : List[Value],
              ∃ lh : Lholed,
                i < LENGTH(l)
                && es == lfill(
                     lh,
                     APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(i + lh_depth(lh)))]))
                && EL(i, l, s, f, vs)
                && (
                     ∀ s2 : Wstore,
                       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
                         ∀ es2 : List[Einstr],
                           reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2) → tlsf_safer_abort(
                             n,
                             s2,
                             f2,
                             es2,
                             q,
                             l,
                             rq,
                             ab)))
     || (
          ∃ vs : List[Value],
            ∃ lh : Lholed,
              es == lfill(lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)]))
              && rq(s, f, vs))
     || es == [Trap] && ab(s, f)
     || (
          ∃ s2 : Wstore,
            ∃ f2 : Wframe, ∃ es2 : List[Einstr], reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2))
        && (
             ∀ s2 : Wstore,
               ∀ f2 : Wframe,
                 ∀ es2 : List[Einstr],
                   reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2) → tlsf_safer_abort(
                     n,
                     s2,
                     f2,
                     es2,
                     q,
                     l,
                     rq,
                     ab)))

entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es1 es2 : List[Einstr]) (q r rq : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn]) (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool)
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, es1, q, l, rq, ab)
  2. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe,
         ∀ vs : List[Value],
           ∀ m : Num,
             m <= n → q(s, f, vs) → tlsf_safer_abort(
               m,
               s,
               f,
               APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), es2),
               r,
               l,
               rq,
               ab)
then
  tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, APPEND(es1, es2), r, l, rq, ab)

entries.name: tlsf_safer_abort_mono
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (ab ab2 : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe)
  (es : List[Einstr]) (q q2 rq rq2 : Assn) (l l2 : List[Assn])
if
  1. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], q(s, f, vs) → q2(s, f, vs)
  2. LENGTH(l2) == LENGTH(l)
  3. ∀ i : Num,
       ∀ s : Wstore,
         ∀ f : Wframe,
           ∀ vs : List[Value],
             i < LENGTH(l) && EL(i, l, s, f, vs) → EL(i, l2, s, f, vs)
  4. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], rq(s, f, vs) → rq2(s, f, vs)
  5. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ab(s, f) → ab2(s, f)
  6. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, es, q, l, rq, ab)
then
  tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, es, q2, l2, rq2, ab2)

entries.name: tlsf_safer_abort_label
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe)
  (vs0 : List[Value]) (e0 li : List[Einstr]) (qb lb q rq : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, li, qb, CONS(lb, l), rq, ab)
  2. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], qb(s, f, vs) → q(s, f, APPEND(vs0, vs))
  3. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe,
         ∀ vs : List[Value],
           ∀ k : Num,
             k <= n → lb(s, f, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
             && tlsf_safer_abort(
                  k,
                  s,
                  f,
                  APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), e0)),
                  q,
                  l,
                  rq,
                  ab)
then
  tlsf_safer_abort(
    n,
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, li)]),
    q,
    l,
    rq,
    ab)

entries.name: tlsf_safer_abort_label_top

∀ (n m : Num) (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe)
  (li : List[Einstr]) (qb rb : Assn)
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, li, qb, [qb], rb, ab)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], qb(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
then
  tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, [Label(m, NIL, li)], qb, NIL, rb, ab)

entries.name: tlsf_frame_abort_can_step
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool) (s : Wstore) (f0 f1 : Wframe)
  (vs0 : List[Value]) (es : List[Einstr]) (qin rin : Assn)
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(SUC(n), s, f1, es, qin, NIL, rin, ab)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], rin(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
then
  ∃ (s2 : Wstore) (f2 : Wframe) (es2 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), s2, f2, es2)

entries.name: tlsf_frame_abort_next
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool) (s s2 : Wstore)
  (f0 f1 f2 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value]) (es es2 : List[Einstr])
  (qin rin : Assn)
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(SUC(n), s, f1, es, qin, NIL, rin, ab)
  2. reduce(s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), s2, f2, es2)
  3. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], rin(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
then
  ∃ (f1' : Wframe) (es' : List[Einstr]),
    tlsf_safer_abort(n, s2, f1', es', qin, NIL, rin, ab)
    && f2 == f0
    && es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1', es')])
or
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f0
  && ∃ vs : List[Value],
       es2 == MAP(v_to_e, APPEND(vs0, vs)) && (qin(s, f1, vs) || rin(s, f1, vs))
or
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f0
  && es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Trap])
  && ab(s, f1)

entries.name: tlsf_frame_abort_safe
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (s : Wstore) (f0 f1 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value])
  (es : List[Einstr]) (qin rin q : Assn) (ain ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool)
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f1, es, qin, NIL, rin, ain)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
         ∀ vs2 : List[Value], qin(s2, f2, vs2) → q(s2, f0, APPEND(vs0, vs2))
  3. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
         ∀ vs2 : List[Value],
           rin(s2, f2, vs2) → LENGTH(vs2) == m && q(s2, f0, APPEND(vs0, vs2))
  4. ∀ s2 : Wstore, ∀ f2 : Wframe, ain(s2, f2) → ab(s2, f0)
then
  safe_abort(n, s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), q, ab)

entries.name: tlsf_sl_abort_r
entries.statement:
tlsf_sl_abort_r(
  (fs : List[Cl]),
  (tabs : Tabs),
  (inst : Inst),
  (rp : SAssn),
  (P : SAssn),
  (bs : List[B_e]),
  (Q : SAssn),
  (ls : List[SAssn]),
  (A : SAssn)) == (
  ∀ n : Num,
    ∀ fr : HProp,
      ∀ s : Wstore,
        ∀ f : Wframe,
          ∀ vs : List[Value],
            keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(P, fr), s, f, vs) → tlsf_safer_abort(
              n,
              s,
              f,
              APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), MAP(Basic, bs)),
              keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(Q, fr)),
              MAP(keep(fs, tabs, inst), MAP((x : SAssn) => lift(x, fr), ls)),
              keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(rp, fr)),
              (s : Wstore) => (f : Wframe) =>
                keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(A, fr), s, f, NIL)))

entries.name: tlsf_safer_abort_to_abort
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q rq : Assn)
  (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool)
if
  1. ∀ s2 : Wstore, ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], !rq(s2, f2, vs)
  2. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, es, q, NIL, rq, ab)
then
  safe_abort(n, s, f, es, q, ab)

if

  2. tlsf_sl_abort_r(fs, tabs, inst, rp, Q, bs2, R, ls, A)

  (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if

then
  tlsf_sl_abort_r(

entries.name: tlsf_sl_abort_r_conseq
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp P P2 Q Q2 A A2 : SAssn)
  (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, P2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → P(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  2. tlsf_sl_abort_r(fs, tabs, inst, rp, P, bs, Q, ls, A)
  3. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, Q(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → Q2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  4. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, A(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → A2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
then
  tlsf_sl_abort_r(fs, tabs, inst, rp, P2, bs, Q2, ls, A2)

entries.name: tlsf_sl_abort_r_weaken
entries.statement:

∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn])
  (initialize_idx page_idx take_idx ensure_idx pop push lim i : Num)

  (xs ps bs z : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before : Heap) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(n) <= 4160749568
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_page_allocate_code(take_idx))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32),
           T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_pop_code(d))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_push_code(d))
  3. n == 0w
     || val(n) <= 256
        && (
             !(fast(DIV(val(n) + 7, 8)) == NIL)
             || !(partial(DIV(val(n) + 7, 8)) == NIL)
             || !(tlsf_search(1080w, fl, sb, bl) == 0w))
     || 256 < val(n) && !(tlsf_search(n, fl, sb, bl) == 0w)

  sl_triple_g(
    G,

    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>

        d,

        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        ps,
        sz,
        loc,
        cached,
        live,
        fast,

        n,

        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,

    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>

            ∃ out3 : Value,
              ∃ out4 : Value,
                lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(n)), out0, out1, out2, out3, out4]
                && (
                     ∃ ptr : W32,
                       res == [V_num(ConstInt32(ptr))]
                       && !(ptr == 4294967295w)
                       && tlsf_full_malloc_post(
                            d,
                            lim,
                            top,
                            xs,
                            hd,
                            fl,

                            bl,
                            ps,
                            sz,
                            loc,
                            cached,
                            live,
                            fast,
                            partial,
                            n,
                            before,
                            fp,
                            res,

    tlsf_malloc_start_full_tail(

    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>

    [

               tlsf_push_code(d))
          && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, ensure_idx), fs) == Func_native(
               inst,
               Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
               [T_num(T_i32)],
               tlsf_ensure_code(d, pop, push)))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, full_idx), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32),
           T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_full_malloc_code(
            d,
            initialize_idx,
            page_idx,
            take_idx,
            ensure_idx))
  2. keep(
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       lift(
         st(
           [V_num(ConstInt32(n))],
           caller,
           tlsf_initialize_saved(d, lim, before, fp)),
         fr),
       s,
       f,
       vs)
  3. reduce_trans(
       (s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), MAP(Basic, [Call(full_idx)]))),
       (s2, f2, es2))
then
  ∃ (res : List[Value]),
    es2 == MAP(v_to_e, res)
    && keep(
         fs,
         tabs,
         inst,
         lift(
           (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
           (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
             lc == caller
             && tlsf_full_malloc_start_post(
                  d,
                  n,
                  lim,
                  before,
                  fp,
                  vs,
                  gs,
                  ms,
                  h),
           fr),
         s2,
         f2,
         res)
or
  es2 == [Trap]
  && (
       (s : Wstore) => (f : Wframe) =>
         keep(
           fs,
           tabs,
           inst,
           lift(tlsf_malloc_start_abort(d, lim, before, fp), fr),
           s,
           f,
           NIL))(s2, f2)
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)
